description.fix: Pins the selected geometry in place.
description.coincident: Makes the selected points share one location.
description.horizontal: Aligns the selected line or points along the horizontal axis.
description.vertical: Aligns the selected line or points along the vertical axis.
description.parallel: Makes the selected lines parallel; the first one stays the reference.
description.perpendicular: Makes the selected lines meet at a right angle; the first one stays the reference.
description.tangent: Makes the selected curves touch without crossing.
description.equal: Gives the selected lines or curves the same length or radius.
description.distance: Sets the length of a line, the distance between points, from a point to a line, a circle or an arc, or between two circles.
description.horizontalDistance: Sets the horizontal distance between two points, or from a point to a line or a circle.
description.verticalDistance: Sets the vertical distance between two points, or from a point to a line or a circle.
description.angle: Sets the angle between two lines or the sweep of an arc.
description.arcLength: Sets the length of the arc.
description.radius: Sets the radius of the circle or arc.
description.diameter: Sets the diameter of the circle or arc.
description.symmetric: Places the selected points symmetrically about a line.
description.pointOnLine: Keeps the point on the line.
description.pointOnCircle: Keeps the point on the circle or arc.
description.pointOnEllipse: Keeps the point on the ellipse.
